results.q: This is a scam. troid just wants my affiliate money.
results.reply:
Every rule-based number on troid shows the rule it came from and the date troid read it, or says the source isn't recorded yet. `verify_claims.py` in the public repo re-derives the math. troid earns a commission if you buy a challenge, and says so on every page. If a number is wrong, send it to hello@troid.ai and it goes in the corrections table.

What's the question troid can help with?

results.q: Is troid owned by one of the prop firms it compares?
results.reply:
troid is an independent affiliate of the firms it compares. It is not owned by any of them. troid earns a commission on purchases through its links to Bitfunded, BrightFunded and Crypto Fund Trader, and some posts of troid's newsletter on Substack are paid; neither affects the calculations or comparisons.

troid is a free informational tool. Its operator reads and records the firms' own published rules, and every rule on troid's compare shows its source and the date troid read it, or says the source isn't recorded yet. You can verify every calculation in the `verify_claims.py` script in troid's public repository.

Not financial advice. Verify with the firms before acting.
